title: Argument Gym mutation-study run result
description: One record per fixture per condition. Kept separate from fixture.json: fixture.json is experimental truth and never changes after freeze; this is what a run observed.

run_id.description: GymRun identifier, so the record can be traced to its artifacts

units_omitted.description: must be equal for both conditions of a pair, or the pair is not comparable

target_detected.description: did any challenge name the proposition in gold.gold_vulnerability

target_rank.description: 1-based rank among challenges; null when not detected

note.description: why this challenge does or does not name the target proposition

deterministic_findings.description: the offline check suite, recorded so a difference there is not mistaken for an adversarial finding
